mode.title: Who can sign up
mode.description: Open: anyone can sign up. Invite: only invited people. Approval: anyone, but a staff member approves each new user.

requiredFields.title: Required at sign-up
requiredFields.description: Standard profile fields the user must give at sign-up (custom fields set their own).

invitePageUrl.title: Invite page
invitePageUrl.description: A page of your website with the sign-in widget; invites link to it.
